subject: BAA availability, PHI scope, and evidence request to progress deployment decision
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kovac <anna.kovac@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — PHI handling and next steps

Hi Anna — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on what MedSys needs and what we can provide: 

Recap:
- MedSys indicated you will be sending/processing PHI across: patient identifiers, clinical notes (unstructured), and scanned documents.
- Priority: data residency in US, signed BAA required, and evidence of SOC 2 Type II + pen test summary.
- Deployment preference: dedicated or private (you said dedicated is preferred if we can provide isolation and the necessary controls).

What we can do / clarifications: 
- BAA: Redwood can enter a BAA for Dedicated and Private deployments. Hosted (our public shared-hosted API) is not eligible for PHI under standard contracts unless we set up a custom enterprise arrangement — we should avoid assuming hosted unless Legal flags it.
- Eligible modes for PHI: Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) and Private (VPC/on-prem). Both support encryption at-rest and customer-managed keys.
- Evidence: attaching a short SOC 2 summary and our standard BAA template for your review.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Rafael (cc'd) to share the SOC 2 attestation and any extra security materials we can provide immediately.
2) Anna/MedSys to confirm whether PHI will be stored at rest by Redwood or only transiently passed through (this affects encryption and retention discussions).
3) Please initiate your vendor security questionnaire (I saw a link in calendar notes). If you prefer, we can kick it off from our side — either way please share the portal link and a deadline.
4) If Dedicated is the selected path, we will provide a deployment options matrix (attached) and a short checklist of operational items (networking, KMS, logging).

If the above matches, I’ll loop in Solutions Engineering for an architecture sketch and Rafael will attach the requested docs. Thanks — looking to keep momentum and get this tied into your procurement timeline.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0173

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_summary_2025.pdf; redwood_BAA_template_v1.docx; deployment_options_matrix.xlsx
From: Anna Kovac <anna.kovac@medsyshealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legalops@medsyshealth.com>, IT Security <itsec@medsyshealth.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Quick sync — PHI handling and next steps

Thanks Olga — that recap is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- PHI scope: we will be sending patient identifiers, problem lists, and clinician notes. Some documents will be persisted in the app (so yes, stored at rest).
- Residency: must be in the US.
- Preferred deployment: Dedicated is preferred for now; Private (VPC) is on the table if Dedicated cannot meet certain controls.

We have a vendor security questionnaire in our portal (link below). Can Redwood complete it directly? If easier, our security team (itsec) can start with the high-level items and we can then follow with the technical Qs. Timeline: procurement wants evidence by EOD next Wednesday (2026-04-08).

Portal link: https://medsyshealth.secure-portal.com/vsq/ABC123

Also please confirm you can provide: SOC 2 Type II report (full), a recent pen test summary, and a diagram showing how keys are managed (KMS details).

Anna
Anna Kovac
Lead PM, Integrations | MedSys Health
anna.kovac@medsyshealth.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kovac <anna.kovac@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Re: Quick sync — PHI handling and next steps

Anna — thanks for the clear scope. A few concrete notes from Legal/Sales ops to move this forward: 

1) BAA: Redwood is willing to sign a standard BAA for Dedicated and Private deployments. I have attached our BAA template; we can iterate. Hosted shared-tenant API is not part of our standard BAA offering due to multi-tenant risk.
2) Evidence we can provide immediately: SOC 2 Type II summary (attached) and a redacted SOC 2 report under NDA. We also have a recent third-party pen test executive summary we can share.
3) Technical deliverables we will prepare this week if Dedicated is chosen: deployment diagram, KMS & encryption at-rest process, network isolation diagram, and an operations runbook for incident response.
4) Vendor questionnaire: happy to complete the VSQ in your portal. Priyom (cc'd) will own the security questionnaire response and should receive portal access. Priyom, please create a folder and pull the docs from attached list; target turnaround for initial completion: 48-72 hours.

Action items: 
- Anna: confirm portal access for priom.das@redwood.com or provide a temporary one-time link.
- MedSys: confirm whether redaction/NDA will be needed for the full SOC 2 report.
- Redwood: Rafael/Priyom will upload SOC 2 summary, pen test exec summary, and BAA template to the portal once access is granted.

Rafael Mendes
Director, Commercial Legal | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_BAA_template_v1.docx; redwood_SOC2_summary_2025.pdf
From: Anna Kovac <anna.kovac@medsyshealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legalops@medsyshealth.com>, IT Security <itsec@medsyshealth.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 16:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Re: Re: Quick sync — PHI handling and next steps

Great — I can confirm portal access for priom.das@redwood.com (temporary token sent). Legal Ops will likely request an NDA/redaction before sharing the full SOC 2 report; that is fine — please upload the summary and pen test exec summary first.

Additional asks from IT Security: 
- Short deployment diagram showing where PHI will reside and encryption boundaries (storage vs transit).
- Confirmation of encryption at-rest algorithms and whether customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported for Dedicated.
- Clarification on logging/retention: we need an SLA for log retention and audit log exports for at least 1 year.

Procurement timeline: aiming to have the VSQ partially completed and initial evidence uploaded by 2026-04-08. If Redwood can meet that, we will move to contract negotiation the following week.

Thanks all — Anna

Attachments: none
